notes: Six Contradicted claims are clinical-wording. Four are the S20 next-step lines (MainActivity.kt:591-594), which differ from doc 6 Section 3 and drop the danger-sign advice. They are not visible in v1.0 because triageEnabled=false shows the cannot-screen card. The other two are 'diagnostic' in about_intended_use and bilirubin/hyperbilirubinemia jargon on S20 and S14. Other top risks: S19 hardcodes a NO_FURTHER_ACTION result with made-up estimates instead of calling the pipeline, and only triageEnabled=false hides it. S07 fabricates a QUALIFIED result and no qualification gate exists before the screening camera. S16 has no CameraX binding, so S17 and the quality-retry loop are unreachable. Research mode (the v1.0 target) cannot be reached from Home or Settings: R01 accepts any PIN, R02 to R07 run on hardcoded data, and R08/R09 are PlaceholderScreen although real composables exist. The selected language is never applied. The banned-word lint uses whole-word matching on one strings.xml only, so it misses 'diagnostic', 'Accuracy' and the R07 literal 'safe'. The TC-UI-01 test asserts only that the enum has 4 values. S14 logs R3/R4 as BLOOD_TEST_TODAY while showing Cannot screen (MainActivity.kt:479). S10 pre-fills birth time to 48 h ago, which looks like a silent default on a clinical input (CLAUDE.md rule). Bangla text was not compared beyond key presence.
